verdict.rationale: Angular ships a documented official CLI at angular.dev/cli. It covers the full lifecycle: creating workspaces, serve, unit and e2e tests, lint, i18n extraction, update, add, config, deploy and cache. The CLI is scriptable, so an AI-native user or agent can drive it, and angular.dev separately advertises AI-forward resources and serves an llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-specific CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output or an AI/MCP subcommand), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI workflows.
